crossRefs.note: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

translations.web: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”
translations.bsb: But Edom answered, “You may not travel through our land, or we will come out and confront you with the sword.”
translations.kjv: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
translations.asv: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against thee.
